params.message:
The headers hand writes nginx too, when the repo carries the config

afrodidact.org runs on its own machine behind nginx, so its headers are a
line in a server block and not in any framework. That line lives on a box,
and this hand does not touch boxes; but that project keeps its config
under version control and copies it out on deploy, and there the header is
a line in a file like any other.

So a third target: a *.conf under deploy/nginx that names this host in
exactly one `server_name <host>;` line gets the add_header lines inserted
in that block, with always, so an error page carries them too. Two
refusals keep it honest: a config that already uses add_header anywhere
(nginx drops every inherited one where a location sets its own), and a
host named in more than one block, where which block serves it would be a
guess.
